limits: Static review does not prove actual GPU execution, memory sufficiency or absence of runtime issues.
GPU shared-memory check is instantaneous; it does not reserve memory from other jobs.
Fresh zero-LoRA actor/reference may have zero measured KL; nonzero k1/k3 paths have separate CPU tests.
No optimizer states are allocated; recorded peak cannot certify training peak.
All-zero signal batches deliberately fail without resampling or replacing rewards.
